test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 25 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the name of the autobiography written by Mr Abhinav Bindra, the Olympic medallist from India?
solution:
The correct option is __**A shot at History.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Abhinav Apjit Bindra** is an **Indian Olympic gold medallist**, retired sports shooter, and businessman.
 
• He is the first Indian to win an Individual Olympic Gold Medal in the 2008 Summer Olympics.
 
• He is the recipient of the Padma Bhushan from the Government of India and is one of the top influencers of sports policy in the country.
 
• In 2018, Abhinav was bestowed with the prestigious Blue Cross, the ISSF's highest honor.
 
• In the 2016 Summer Olympics in Rio de Janeiro, Bindra finished fourth in the finals of the 10-meter air rifle event.
 
• On September 5, 2016, he announced his retirement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Courage and Conviction

 
 
• It is an autobiographical book by Indian General Vijay Kumar Singh written with Shiv Kunal Verma.
 
• It was first published by Aleph Book Company in 2013.
 
 
 
• All from Memory
 
 
• This autobiography is by a Senior - Advocate Acharya B.V, with more than 57 years of practice at the Bar.
 
• The Book part from recalling his childhood and student days provides a glimpse of life in his early days where there was poverty, illiteracy, and backwardness in all spheres.
 
 
 
• The Autobiography 
 
 
• This is the autobiography of Bertrand Russel.
 
• He was a British philosopher, logician, and public intellectual
